title: Terminal reap delay, per-pool override and exceptions
prerequisites: Only disposable QA-owned workspaces with recorded IDs and explicitly approved worker-exit/failure fixture; preserve production pools and shared host.
Use active QA template with autostop deadline later than intended reap window; record latest workspace build completion UTC (not runner exit) and provider redelivery times.
Capture private QA status, reaper verdicts, builds and provider outcome every 30s; do not promise Claude redelivery will wait full 2m.

Q09-d.fixture: QA-only dispatch failure, failed delete and autostop preemption in separate disposable workspaces

variants.title: 2m global retention for clean Claude and failed Cursor

steps.action: Apply global reapDelay 2m to dedicated QA relay and restart. Finish Claude cleanly and produce one controlled failed Cursor runner on distinct QA workspaces; record each latest build completion and exit UTC.
steps.expected: Both reach terminal status; build completion and autostop deadlines known before asserting delay.
steps.evidence: Config hash, provider/workspace/build IDs and UTC completion/exit times.

steps.action: Observe each at completion+0,+90s,+120s,+180s and poll every 30s through sweep after deadline; inspect Cursor fail-claim applied outcome.
steps.expected: When no earlier autostop or redelivery intervenes, workspace retained before completion+120s; after deadline next sweep reports failed Cursor claim and deletes workspace; clean Claude deleted without failure. If Claude redelivery changes build completion, recalculate deadline and report best-effort rather than force a strict 2m assertion.
steps.evidence: Timestamped workspace existence, latest build completion, verdict/fail counter and redacted provider outcome.

cleanup: Remove failure fixture and restore reapDelay 0s; verify authorized QA workspace cleanup.

variants.title: Cursor zero override

steps.action: Apply global 2m and Cursor reap_delay 0s; restart QA relay, fail only a disposable Cursor runner and record build completion UTC.
steps.expected: Cursor failure reporting/deletion occurs at next eligible sweep without 2m hold; unaffected Claude pool still has 2m effective setting.
steps.evidence: Config hash, timestamps and sanitized verdict/fail outcome.

cleanup: Remove override and fault, restore global 0s, confirm targeted QA cleanup.

variants.title: Claude zero override

steps.action: Apply global 2m and Claude reap_delay 0s; restart QA relay, cleanly end a disposable Claude runner and record build completion UTC.
steps.expected: Claude workspace deleted at next eligible sweep without 2m hold; Cursor setting remains inherited 2m.
steps.evidence: Config hash, timestamps and sanitized reaper verdict.

cleanup: Remove override, restore global 0s and confirm QA workspace absence.

variants.title: Bypass for dispatch failure, delete retry and autostop

steps.action: With global 2m only on dedicated QA relay, separately trigger approved scoped QA dispatch-time build failure, failed delete retry and a disposable workspace whose autostop precedes 2m deadline.
steps.expected: Each exception has a recorded cause and build/deadline timeline; no non-QA workspace affected.
steps.evidence: Three distinct QA IDs, sanitized fixture records, build status and deadlines.

steps.action: For each, poll reaper and build history every 30s over at least two sweeps.
steps.expected: Dispatch-time failure and failed delete retry do not wait 2m; impending autostop preempts delay. No fabricated 2m guarantee for runner never started or a rebuilt/redelivered session.
steps.evidence: UTC event order, reaper verdict and sanitized provider failure outcome.

cleanup: Disable each scoped fixture; restore reapDelay 0s and delete only explicitly authorized disposable QA workspaces.

notes: Sweep interval is a 30s gap between sweeps, not exact fixed schedule; a timeout is a failed observation, not a latency guarantee.
Log level debug may expose sensitive data: use only ephemeral private viewing and publish redacted summaries, not raw debug logs.
